notes: CAR THEFT MINIGAME (Motor Vehicle Theft passage): Timed puzzle — 40s countdown, random problem (Car alarm/Radio turns on/Someone is coming/Ignition). Choose correct action from 3 options per problem (Hit steering/Break glass/Focus seen for alarm) or 'Think of some other options...' to reroll. 'Run away' bails. Success steals the $target_car from outskirts_cars array, adds bikers_heat 6-9 + heat 3-7. Gated Outskirts 21:00-03:00, needs Car Opening Tools + stam >= 1.

RACING/CAR CHASE (Outskirts Racing linkappend at 20:00-03:00, $race_active=true, entry 1000$, $car>0, $race_cd=0): Minigame passage 'Car Chase' — 3-button directional minigame (Left/Keep on/Right), random problem appears each turn from $chase_problems array, correct direction in $chase_right_dir reduces remaining distance ($chase_success km), wrong direction costs 1 car HP ($chase_hp). Timer $chase_timer counts down in realtime (40ms repeat). Win conditions: reach chase_success<=0 → 'Car Chase Success' (racer_success widget rewards). Lose: timer expires OR hp<1 → 'Car Chase Lose' (flavor: lost entry fee only, minor cosmetic damage). Shortcut: CUN>=11 'Breeze through' auto-win. ALSO reused for car theft chase flow (chase_type distinguishes).

MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT detailed: 90-100s countdown timer ($timer_seconds / $starting_timer_vehicle). Need $theft_solutions_needed correct solves. Each turn reads random $car_theft_problem from $vehicle_problem pool ('Radio turns on'/'Someone is coming'/'Ignition'/'Alarm turns on'). 3 option buttons — real answer is hidden in the pool, wrong guess loses time. 'Think of some other options...' refreshes option set (reroll). Timeout → Motor Vehicle Caught (<<car_thief_fail>> widget = arrest path). Success → Motor Vehicle Theft Success. Pure pattern-recognition minigame, no skill gate on win, but alarms during night add heat/rep drops on fail.
